summary: Iteration 66 — full E2E testing of Phase 1 (APM Applications, Run & Exploitation, Sécurité, Architecture) + Phase 2 (methodology-based indicators EVM/vélocité/SAFe, Participatory Budgeting SAFe) + heatmap build+run integration. Backend: 34/34 pytest passed (100 %). Frontend: navigation, DSI pages, tabs, CRUD add buttons, Pilotage portfolio, PB vote flow, TIME matrix and Application CRUD all working. ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG found and fixed by tester: the new 'Pilotage' tab was declared in ProjectDetail.jsx conditional (line 1752) but was NOT added to the tabs array (line 416-425) — the whole Phase 2 indicator UI (ind-cpi, ind-spi, ind-velocity, ind-predictability, sprint-add-btn) was unreachable. Added the tab entry; re-test passed.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Pilotage' tab was missing from the tabs definition array (lines 418-425) even though its conditional block exists at line 1752 (`{activeTab === 'pilotage' && ...}`). Consequently ind-cpi/ind-spi (waterfall), ind-velocity/ind-predictability (agile/safe) and sprint-add-btn (sprint entry) were unreachable from the UI. TESTER FIX APPLIED: inserted `{ id: 'pilotage', label: 'Pilotage' }` between 'equipe' and 'benefices'. All Phase 2 indicators now render correctly on both the waterfall project (343282cb…) and the SAFe project (21fa6d43…).

action_items: Main agent: keep the ProjectDetail Pilotage tab entry that the tester added. Verify the tab renders consistently across all methodologies.
Consider adding an ESLint / test that ensures every `activeTab === X` branch has a matching entry in the tabs array to prevent the same class of bug (dead tab conditionals).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx is 2071 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Its Pilotage tab conditional was easy to overlook because the tabs array lives ~1300 lines away from the render branch. Recommend extracting each tab pane into its own component (Overview.jsx, Tasks.jsx, PilotageTab.jsx, …).

Router pattern in DSI modules is duplicated (applications/run/security/architecture all do the same PATTERN of GET/POST/PUT/DELETE + `_require_write`). SimpleCrud handles part of it but Applications and Run duplicate boilerplate. Consider generalising.

PB submit_vote does not call require_dsi_write — this is intentional (any authenticated user must be able to vote in SAFe LPM), but READ_ONLY viewer can also vote. Confirm this is the intended product decision; if not, gate voting behind a `pb.vote` permission.
run/service.py `_sla_met` swallows all datetime parsing errors → returns None silently. Fine, but worth logging so seed/import issues surface.

rca of the issue: ProjectDetail.jsx grew to 2071 lines. When Phase 2 added the Pilotage tab, the developer added the conditional render block at line 1752 (`{activeTab === 'pilotage' && <ProjectIndicators .../>}`) but forgot to add the corresponding tab entry in the tabs button array at lines 417-425. As a result the pilotage view was rendered ONLY if activeTab was set to 'pilotage', which was never possible via the UI. Reproduction (before fix): login admin → /projects/343282cb-… → no 'Pilotage' tab visible (only Aperçu/Tâches/Jalons/Risques/Décisions/Équipe/Business case). Fix: add `{ id: 'pilotage', label: 'Pilotage' }` to the tabs list.
